old: During hyperinflation, prices jumped to double every fifteen hours.
new: At the peak of the hyperinflation, prices roughly doubled every fifteen hours.

old: Enterprise bonuses were in direct proportion to the quality of goods brought to market.
new: The reformers wanted enterprise bonuses to be in direct proportion to profit.

old: The Győr plant operates on an area twice as large as at the beginning.
new: The new plant operates on an area twice as large as the old one.

old: The automotive industry generates three times as much export revenue as agriculture.
new: The new factory makes three times as many cars as the old one.

old: Compared to the pre-crisis state, twice as much foreign direct investment arrived in the country.
new: Compared to the plan, twice as many orders arrived at the factory.

old: The export of innovative enterprises jumped to several times its former level thanks to the EU single market.
new: The exports of some innovative enterprises jumped to several times their former level thanks to the EU single market.
